sql.eventType.getTypesForCompany: select id, company_id, event_type, archived from flow.event_type where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true order by event_type
sql.eventType.getType: select id, company_id, event_type, archived from flow.event_type where id = :id
sql.eventType.deleteType: update flow.event_type set archived = true where id = :id
sql.eventType.updateType: update flow.event_type set event_type = :eventType where id = :id
